description: Search products from hangel Market partner stores (store, stock status, donation rate, and the price when it was confirmed at the store within the last 21 days; otherwise price is null and priceStatus is "check_at_store").  The donation rate is the approximate share of a purchase made through hangel that reaches the NGO the buyer chose, after hangel's share and taxes are taken from the commission the brand pays (for example a 10% commission shows as about 5.5%). The catalogue is mostly Turkish, so Turkish product words work best.

limit.description: Maximum number of results (default 20, at most 50).

minDonationRate.description: Minimum donation rate in percent, compared with the rate that reaches the NGO (the value returned as donationRate).

query.description: Product search phrase, for example "koşu ayakkabısı" (running shoes) or "iphone 17".

name: search_products
title: Search hangel Market products
